Dan — attached is a focused evidence checklist mapped to your CAIQ subset plus an initial set of responses in the SIG workbook. Quick highlights and clarifications: 
- Evidence: I9ve linked artifact names in the checklist (configuration screenshots, policy docs, and sample SOC auditor letter pages).
- Data retention defaults:
  - Customer-generated content: retained while account is active + 90-day backup hold (to support restore & for a short offboarding buffer).
  - Backups: encrypted snapshots retained for up to 90 days by default.
  - Audit logs and admin activity logs: retained for 24 months (2 years).
  - Embeddings/derived indices: treated as customer data; retention follows the same contract-term + 90-day model unless explicitly configured otherwise.
- Export requests: we retain exported copies delivered to customers per the same retention schedule unless BankCo requests a shorter retention window in the DPA.

If BankCo requires longer archival retention (e.g., 7 years), that will need to be added to the DPA and we9ll flag cost/operational impacts.

Planned deliverables: SIG workbook (initial answers) by 2027-04-28, evidence checklist CSV and links by 2027-04-23 (attached). Happy to run a 30-min technical evidence walkthrough with IT Risk.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
